failure_policy: Preserve every planned dataset and unsuccessful fit. Failed or unattempted planned permutations remain unknown within B599; never condition the denominator on successful fits. Do not replace a source-run failure with a successful duplicate from another run.
execution_implementation: Use the HPC-validated direct normal-PDF objective with unchanged arithmetic/optimizer. This single-engine run recomputes nuisance for every new label permutation. No mixture reuse across schemes, datasets or permutations.
freeze_policy: Immutable source/config snapshot created before any42xxxxxx confirmation data are generated. Earlier41xxxxxx structural-preflight data are excluded. Changes prompted by confirmation outcomes require a new candidate and fresh seeds.
full_p_policy: Absolute seeds 42200000 through 42200009, shared with the K27 panel, complete B599. The ten-dataset full-p subset remains diagnostic only.
primary_endpoint: Global-max detection probability at exact K14 and K55 separately for e2/e4 alternatives, R500 per cell. Combine graphically with the existing K27 global estimates to form a six-cell finite-N D-max power panel.
geometry_policy: Uniform relative permutations conditional on the declared exact inversion count among 14 biomarkers. Fixed sample_scale=1 and REF nuisance. Assert planned=realized K per dataset. No monotonicity, minimum detectable distance, sample-size or distance-only power claim.

replication_accounting.shared_seed_policy: Shared seeds couple K and alternative-group contrasts. Each of the six cell-specific rates has R500; do not flatten the cells into an independent R3000 calibration sample.
